subject: NVIDIA’s Auto Ontology 🗂️, Less Coding, More Judgment 👥, Mapping LLM Conversations 💬
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs, funds or model pricing in this issue; only product and release news.

stories.headline: NVIDIA releases Apache-licensed Auto Ontology, turning database metadata into a semantic graph for agents
stories.quote: NVIDIA's Apache-licensed Auto Ontology turns database metadata into a semantic graph that humans can review and certify, and agents can access over MCP, API, or CLI.

facts.text: Auto Ontology maps business terms, certified SQL attributes and relationships to underlying data to generate queries and disclose provenance.
facts.quote: It maps business terms, certified SQL attributes, and relationships to underlying data so it can generate queries and disclose their provenance.

stories.headline: PostgreSQL ships patch releases for all supported branches and 19 RC 2; PostgreSQL 14 reaches end-of-life
stories.quote: PostgreSQL shipped patch releases for all supported branches, fixing 52 security vulnerabilities and more than 140 bugs. PostgreSQL 14 is now end-of-life, so production teams should upgrade to a supported version.

stories.headline: PyPI launches redesigned project pages with a security tab showing release file origins
stories.quote: PyPI has redesigned its package pages with a security tab showing where release files came from and warnings when that information is missing, inconsistent, or unexpectedly changed.
